notes.title: 5_17 Big Patch
notes.content:
[b] 1[/b] : I thought the Defense systems were difficult to feel, so I removed all defensive options and changed them to provide only Max Hp. and buffed many armors.
[b]2[/b] : Increased the efficiency of various low-efficiency foods.
[b]3[/b] : Weapons' balance adjustment : many weapon buffed
[b]4[/b] : Bug Fix - Now you can't tread your mine.
[b]5[/b] : Now when player entered room, door sound is playing!

notes.title: 5_11 Patch!
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fix[/b] : Now, even if you end the game in a way other than the right way, 
the ranking will work properly.
[b]Ping[/b] : Now you can see other player's ping. 
[b]Key Change[/b] : Now space is invent, and right MouseButton is Get item. 

I plan to mac and linux build, and add the custom keysetting feature, boss monster later.
Later, I want to do extra or additional character dlc.
Anything you want to add in game for more fun, and anything uncomfortable,
plaese tell me into review or e-mail!
Thanks! 0v0b

tags.bug: [b]Bug Fix[/b] : Now, even if you end the game in a way other than the right way, the ranking will work properly.

tags.feature: [b]Ping[/b] : Now you can see other player's ping.
